The HWPX supplier contact sheet generation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, confirming the core document automation logic is functional.

Pytest results in 'test_output.py' confirm that 'test_legacy_pytest_suite' passed successfully in 0.12 seconds. While the trajectory was successful, the lower judge reward suggests potential for optimization in code style or edge-case handling within the HWPX generation logic.
